fieldValues.title: checks.json entry tier is unvalidated
fieldValues.summary: Nothing validates the tier field on a checks.json entry, so a typo in a tier name silently disables the check rather than failing loudly. The registry is the one declared home for every conformance check, which makes a silent drop-out worse than an undeclared check.
fieldValues.body: Fixed in check-checks-registry-membership.mjs (already the registry-hygiene guard): every entry's tier is checked against checks.json's own declared tiers array, cell against the twelve Pattern Grid slugs in scripts/lib/pattern-grid-cells.json, and script against the filesystem. Proved by deliberately introducing each violation against the live registry (red), then reverting (green); the same three cases plus a missing-tiers-vocabulary case are now permanent negative tests in tests/guards/run.mjs. Both gates (validate-all.mjs, check-release-drift.mjs) pass. PR srs#630, gate:auto-merge armed.
